title: The Four-horned Antelope: a past life story
html:
• Jātaka Stories of Past Lives 21
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Kuruṅgavagga The Four-horned Antelope

1. Kuruṅgamigajātaka The Four-horned Antelope: a past life story

“Ñātametaṁ kuruṅgassa, The four-horned antelope knows that yaṁ tvaṁ sepaṇṇi siyyasi; it’s you who tosses fruit from the beechwood tree. Aññaṁ sepaṇṇi gacchāmi, I’ll go to another beechwood, na me te ruccate phalan”ti. I don’t like your fruit.

Kuruṅgamigajātakaṁ paṭhamaṁ.
